title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - EORI
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#EORI. The Economic Operators Registration and Identification number. Subclass of RegistrationNumber per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the RegistrationNumber model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EORI'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

eori.description: Property. The Economic Operators Registration and Identification number (EORI).

country.description: Property. The country where the EORI is registered, written in plain English.
